items.problem: `iap-google` receipt verification does not set how the adapter decides whether a receipt (`Purchase.getOriginalJson()`, iap.md:54) is a product receipt checked with `purchases.products` or a subscription receipt checked with `purchases.subscriptionsv2`. The transaction ID, the verification result, the purchase time and the test transaction judgement (iap.md:169) all depend on which response is read, but grant order step 2 (iap.md:127) learns the product type only from the SKU the adapter returns, and no defining document gives the adapter the `iap_product` type or names a receipt field to decide by. Implementations can differ (call `purchases.products` first and fall back, read `autoRenewing` of the receipt JSON, look up `sku_google` in `iap_product`)
